evidence:
REF: hooks/agy/agy_guard.py:150-160
def is_test_file(path_str: str) -> bool:
    p = Path(str(_unquote(path_str or "")))
    name = p.name.lower()
    return (
        name.endswith("_test.go")
        or name.startswith("test_")
        or name.endswith("_test.py")
        or ".test." in name
        or ".spec." in name
        or "/tests/" in p.as_posix().lower()
    )
